name: ub-mode
description: Unofficial, independently written developer workflow inspired by Robert C. Martin (Uncle Bob)'s original ub-mode skill.

interface.longDescription: An independent adaptation of the ub-mode engineering workflow originally published by Robert C. Martin (Uncle Bob). Use test-first changes, root-cause fixes, refactoring, quality checks and a verifiable action log. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author.
defaultPrompt: Use ub-mode to implement this code change in small, tested steps.
Review these changes using ub-mode's quality gates and action log.
Apply ub-mode principles to this refactoring without changing behavior.
